.²1 <ab>N.</ab> of {#pfTA#}, daughter of a Yādava named {#SUra#}, adopted by {#kuntiBoja#}.
 [She was the first wife of Pāṇḍu. As he was prevented by a curse from
 having progeny, he allowed his wife to make use of a charm she had acquired
 from the sage Durvāsas, by means of which she was to have a son by any
 god she liked to invoke. She invoked Dharma, Vāyu and Indra, and had
 from them Yudhiṣṭhira, Bhīma and Arjuna respectively. She was also mother
 of Karṇa by the deity Sun whom she invoked in her virginhood to test her charm.]
.²2 A fragrant resin.
.²3 The wife of a Brāhmaṇa.
